title: Florida Woman’s Monday Morning Bar Crawl Turns Chaotic
description:
A newlywed husband and wife were arrested outside of a bar in Key West, Florida after a ‘drunken’ argument allegedly led to a pick-up truck crashing into the building. Police took Kimberly Robins, 47, and Charles Lambert, 41, into custody after witnesses told police the pair were arguing before Kimberly hopped in the truck and Charles allegedly started hitting her with a towel. Kimberly then allegedly hit the gas sending the black pick-up truck right into the side of the bar causing damage. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
